rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone or something is physically in the midst of and surrounded by others.

example.english: I was standing among the crowd.
example.jyutping: ngo5 kei5 zo2 hai2 jan4 kwan4 zung1 gaan1

rows.note: Use this for something occurring or being common between members of a group, especially people.

example.english: The news spread among my colleagues.
example.traditional: 呢個消息喺同事之間傳遍咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hai2 tung4 si6 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 bin3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when something is distributed or divided so that group A shares it.

example.english: We divided the snacks among the children.
example.traditional: 我哋將啲零食分畀啲細路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 ling4 sik6 fan1 bei2 di1 sai3 lou6

rows.jyutping: hai2 A ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6
rows.note: Use this when among means in the circumstances or context of A.

example.english: In this situation, we can only choose among several plans.
example.traditional: 喺呢個情況下，我哋唯有喺幾個方案之間揀。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 haa6 ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 hai2 gei2 go3 fong1 on3 zi1 gaan1 gaan2
